scripts.dev: prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:netlify: prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run db:netlify -w server && npm run build -w client
